Job Description: Shopify Web Developer / Shopify Landing Page Specialist

We are seeking a talented Shopify Web Developer / Shopify Landing Page Specialist to join our team. As a key member of our e-commerce team, you will play a crucial role in creating visually stunning and highly functional Shopify websites and landing pages that drive conversions and enhance user experience.

Compensation

  • Base Salary: €1,500 – €2,000/month (based on experience)
  • Profit Sharing + Performance Bonuses
  • Top performers earn €2,500 – €3,000/month take-home


  • Responsibilities:
    • Designing, developing, and maintaining Shopify websites and landing pages
    • Customizing Shopify themes to meet specific client requirements
    • Optimizing website performance and user experience
    • Collaborating with the marketing team to implement SEO best practices
    • Testing and troubleshooting website issues
  • Requirements:
    • Proficiency in Shopify platform and Liquid programming language
    • Experience in front-end development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
    • Strong understanding of responsive design principles
    • Knowledge of SEO best practices
    • Excellent problem-solving skills
    • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

What You’ll Get

  • Competitive base salary + profit sharing
  • Opportunity to grow into a long-term senior or lead developer role
  • Exposure to multiple fast-scaling global brands

Our Culture

We work hard, scale fast, and win together.
We believe in ownership, growth, and enjoying the journey—not just grinding.
nivel: Entry (0-2 ani), Middle (2-5 ani), Senior (5-10 ani)
